decisions.quote: Although the finding that participants with lower freewill beliefs were not more likely to act unethically raises questions about the basic hypothesis of interest, our inability to experimentally manipulate the psychological state of interest renders this an unfit test.
decisions.reason: Although both protocols yielded null effects on the manipulation check and focal cheating measure, the authors explicitly judge their attempt to be an 'unfit test' of the hypothesis (and conclude they can say very little about causality) because the manipulations failed to induce the required psychological state. Under the codebook, when authors explicitly state that a design or manipulation failure prevents their study from providing a meaningful test of the original claim, that special verdict ('uninformative') governs the outcome.
